name: legal_plays
protocol_phrase: Call `legal_plays()` when you need the exact legal candidate domino_ids before committing or evaluating plays.

name: play_brief
protocol_phrase: Call `play_brief(play=X)` for a legal candidate play to get a concise outcome summary.

name: belief_trajectory
protocol_phrase: Call `belief_trajectory()` if hidden ownership could distinguish otherwise close legal candidates.

name: board_snapshot
protocol_phrase: Call `board_snapshot()` only if you need to reread or refresh the state summary already provided in the user prompt.
